text:
incident-bot: Pager — elevated error rate and tail latency observed for hosted inference in us-east-1a. Affected routes: /v1/generate (gpt-small, gpt-medium).

mika: saw the alert. 5xx rate up ~6% and p95 latency doubled. looks like a network egress queue backlog on a subset of hosts.

samir: confirming logs: `socket_write_timeout` and `ENETUNREACH` spikes from instances in us-east-1a overlay. small batch workers show connection resets.

alex: switching routing policy to avoid us-east-1a for non-regulated tenants. executing quick steer now.

liz: doing canary steer first 5% -> 25% -> 50%. will post progress.

emma-cs: any customer-facing impact yet? A few support tickets reporting >10s latency. need status page note.

mika: yes, some customer requests time out at 30s. fallback path returns 503 rather than queued tokens.

infra-oncall: investigating host-level NIC metrics. seeing transmit queue growth and qdisc drops. looks like kernel TX scheduling stalls on ~12 hosts. Opening host list now.

samir: start mitigation plan: 1) steer traffic away from us-east-1a; 2) enable immediate fallback model variant (gpt-medium -> gpt-small) for best-effort customers; 3) cordon and drain most-affected nodes; 4) notify status page.

alex: applied steer -> 30% (non-prod and best-effort). CPU on other AZs up but within headroom. No error increase yet.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/network/egress-queue-stall. Recommend kernel bump and NIC reset on queued nodes.

infra-oncall: performing `sudo ethtool -K eth0 tx off` toggles and `sudo ifdown && ifup` on one sample node to validate. Will coordinate drains after validation.

mika: validated rx/tx counters drop after reset on sample node. proceeding with rolling NIC reset + drain for 12 hosts. ETA 18m for full rotation.

emma-cs: drafting status page: "We are investigating increased latency and errors for inference in us-east-1a. Traffic is being routed to other AZs; some customers may see degraded latency." Will blast in 10m.

liz: steer to 60% now. error rate trending down from 6% -> 2.1% after initial reset actions. p95 latency decreasing.

samir: starting model-variant fallback toggle for best-effort tenants to gpt-small. Command: `POST /admin/rollout {"route": "/v1/generate", "variant": "gpt-small", "scope": "best-effort"}`

emma-cs: posted status update and pinned to channel.

infra-oncall: drained and reset 8/12 hosts. queue drops normalized on those. continuing rotation.

alex: what about capacity risk if we keep steering? region headroom shows ~22% spare, should be OK for next 2 hrs.

mika: agree. monitor for cross-AZ saturation. if p90 across region rises >30% then we'll trigger autoscale + temporary quota.

incident-bot: Incident declared: "eus1a-egress-queue-stall". Severity: P2. Pager reassigning to infra-oncall and eng-runtime.

samir: creating follow-up ticket with host IDs and kernel logs: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-1758888000. Add me + infra-oncall.

emma-cs: customer comms: sending targeted note to impacted accounts (best-effort) with mitigation actions and ETA.

liz: handoff to daytime shift in 40m. leaving notes in ticket about which hosts still draining.

infra-oncall: last host reset scheduled in ~12m. will update when complete.

mika: summary: root cause likely transient NIC tx-scheduling stall after vendor firmware background task + spike in ephemeral egress connections. mitigations: NIC resets + rolling drains, traffic steer, model-variant fallback. Monitoring shows improving SLOs.

emma-cs: next steps: post-incident RCA + firmware escalation to cloud provider. sending briefing to account teams now.

alex: thanks all. I'll keep the channel open until rotation done and SLO stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
